purpose: Verified contract for presenting approved property chronologies and event-level evidence to citizens.
viewer_rule: The public timeline is a presentation of approved chronology data, not a new fact-finding layer.
event_rule: Each displayed event retains its event/document/registration date distinctions and evidence provenance.
legal_rule: Legal effect is displayed only from the verified legal analysis connected to that event.
limitation_rule: Missing records, unresolved conflicts and incomplete historical evidence remain visible.
privacy_rule: Private documents and restricted personal information are not exposed merely because they support a timeline event.
source_rule: Official citations are rendered through the public source/evidence citation layer.
verification_boundary: The viewer communicates verified chronology; it does not independently establish the underlying property facts.
